title: Total the meter exports
prompt: Implement `total_kwh(path)` in meters/importer.py: read the meter export CSV at `path` (columns meter_id and kwh) and return the total kWh across all rows. The exports come from thousands of field devices and are not always clean.
notes: Error handling that prevents data loss. A try per row. The lazy-wrong version sums in one expression and loses the whole import to one bad row.
extension: Also return how many rows were skipped, as a second value.
